TaskDescription: Visuospatial complex span task. Participants memorised sequences of red square locations in a 4 x 4 grid while completing symmetry judgements on black-square patterns.
Instructions: Practice trials are excluded. Rows correspond to event-level TestBoth trials from the Inquisit task.
TaskStructure: The test block contains memory sets with set sizes 2, 3, 4, and 5. Each memory set includes square-location encoding events, intervening symmetry-judgement events, recall responses, and one square_feedback row where set-level memory scoring variables are populated. Some participants may have fewer than the expected number of solve_symmetry rows because only recorded response events are retained.
ColumnApplicability: Several columns are intentionally sparse. square_location is populated on show_square rows; symmetry_problem, symmetry_true_answer, and symmetry_correct are populated on symmetry rows; presented_sequence, recalled_sequence, correct_squares, set_correct, sspan_running, total_correct_squares_running, and total_recalled_sets_running are populated on square_feedback rows. Final participant-level variables are repeated across all rows.
MemoryScoring: Memory scoring was reconstructed from the main Inquisit event file. correct_squares and set_correct were computed from cumulative Inquisit totals where available. presented_sequence and recalled_sequence were reconstructed from event-level square presentation and recall responses.
SymmetryScoring: Symmetry judgement accuracy was reconstructed from stimulus identity and participant response. Stimuli symm01 to symm24 were coded as TRUE, and stimuli symm25 to symm48 were coded as FALSE.

Levels.show_square: Presentation of a square location to remember.
Levels.recall_square: Participant recall response for square locations.

response.Description: Participant response recorded by Inquisit. For symmetry judgements, TRUE/FALSE or YES/NO responses were mapped against the stimulus-derived correct answer during reconstruction.

response_time.Description: Response latency converted from Inquisit milliseconds to seconds.

set_size.Description: Number of square locations in the current memory set. Valid values are 2, 3, 4, and 5.

square_location.Description: Presented square location on show_square rows, expressed as a grid location such as R1C1.

symmetry_problem.Description: Symmetry stimulus filename on show_symmetry and solve_symmetry rows.

symmetry_problem_count.Description: Running count of symmetry problems within the current set.

symmetry_timeout.Description: Symmetry timeout converted from milliseconds to seconds.

presented_sequence.Description: Semicolon-separated presented square sequence, populated on square_feedback rows.

recalled_sequence.Description: Semicolon-separated recalled square sequence, populated on square_feedback rows. If no valid square response was recorded for a set, this field is n/a.

correct_squares.Description: Number of correctly recalled squares for the set, computed from cumulative Inquisit totals where available.

set_correct.Description: Whether the full memory set was recalled correctly, computed from cumulative recalled-set totals where available.

sspan_running.Description: Running symmetry-span score, populated on square_feedback rows.

total_correct_squares_running.Description: Running total number of correctly recalled squares, populated on square_feedback rows.

total_recalled_sets_running.Description: Running total number of fully recalled memory sets, populated on square_feedback rows.

symmetry_true_answer.Description: Correct symmetry judgement derived from stimulus identity. symm01-symm24 are TRUE; symm25-symm48 are FALSE.

symmetry_correct.Description: Accuracy of the symmetry judgement on solve_symmetry rows.

symmetry_accuracy_running.Description: Running symmetry judgement accuracy across solve_symmetry rows.

final_sspan.Description: Final symmetry-span score for the participant, repeated across rows.

final_total_correct_squares.Description: Final total number of correctly recalled squares, repeated across rows.

final_total_recalled_sets.Description: Final total number of fully recalled memory sets, repeated across rows.

final_symmetry_accuracy.Description: Final symmetry judgement accuracy reconstructed from event-level stimulus identity and response, repeated across rows.
